summary.key_theme: 公司 第三 季財報表現不如預期，導致市場對其 AI 成長動能產生疑慮，引發股價大幅修正。

bullish.title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Became A Founding Member Of An Enterprise AI Governance Alliance
bullish.reason: Cisco 加入 ServiceNow 的 Control Tower Alliance，顯示其 AI 治理平台在企業市場仍具備戰略吸引力。

bullish.title: BDO Canada partners with ServiceNow to help organizations govern AI and simplify operations
bullish.reason: 透過與 BDO Canada 的合作，擴展了 AI 治理與業務流程自動化的市場應用場景。

bullish.title: Brokers Suggest Investing in ServiceNow (NOW): Read This Before Placing a Bet
bullish.reason: 券商平均建議仍維持買入評級，顯示部分分析師認為股價修正後具備長期投資價值。

bearish.title: ServiceNow shares plunge 25% after earnings revive AI disruption fears
bearish.reason: 第三 季財報表現疲軟，且市場對 AI 帶來的營收貢獻產生質疑，導致股價出現歷史性單日跌幅。

bearish.title: Why ServiceNow Stock Plunged This Week
bearish.reason: 明確指出積壓訂單（backlog）展望疲軟是導致股價下跌的核心原因，抵銷了 AI 題材的正面效應。

bearish.title: ServiceNow's AI Momentum Still Too Small to Inflect Overall Growth, Truist Says
bearish.reason: Truist 分析師指出目前 AI 成長動能尚不足以對整體營收產生顯著影響，打擊市場信心。

bearish.title: Stock Market: Google, Amazon, Intel, ServiceNow Trigger Tech Wreck
bearish.reason: ServiceNow 被列為領跌科技股之一，加劇了市場對該公司短期股價表現的負面情緒。
